contentPattern.structure: heading + subheading + 2 CTAs on left column, 1 cover image on right column

suitableFor: blog index / listing page intros with text + single feature image
section landing pages with a side-by-side text-and-image layout
notSuitableFor: full-bleed image banners with text overlay (use hero-banner)
homepage hero with stacked image gallery (use hero-trendsetters)
